mentions.name: Nodillo
mentions.description: This app is a free node-based solids modeller for 3D printing, carpentry, and hobbyists, roughly similar to Rhino/Grasshopper. It lets users model with nodes, share files, and create shareable configurations, with an intro class planned to teach node-based modeling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a free node based solids modeller perfect for 3d printing, carpentry or hobbyists. Its roughly similar to Rhino/Grasshopper. I call it Nodillo!
